stories.title: FlyDubai Co-Pilot Attacked Captain with Axe, Barred from Flying Over Extremism Concerns
stories.summary: The co-pilot of a FlyDubai flight to Israel, identified as Omani national Hamam al-Hammami, attacked the captain with an axe in what UAE officials describe as an attempted terrorist act. Al-Hammami had previously been barred from flying in Oman due to concerns over extremist views. The incident has raised alarms within the aviation industry, already struggling from recent crises.

stories.title: Coast Guard Searches for Missing Medical Evacuation Jet Off Nantucket
stories.summary: The U.S. Coast Guard is conducting a search for a Gulfstream medical evacuation jet that lost contact with flight controllers early Saturday morning. The aircraft, which was carrying six people, was en route from Bermuda to Boston when it went missing near Nantucket.

stories.title: Christa Pike in Critical Condition After Botched Execution in Tennessee
stories.summary: Christa Pike, a death row inmate, is currently unconscious and on a ventilator following two failed lethal injection attempts in Tennessee. Her attorneys report that she is critically ill and receiving medical care after the execution attempt left her gravely affected. In response to the incident, Tennessee officials have ordered an independent review of the execution process, and the state's prison commissioner has stepped down.

stories.title: Brazil Prepares for Presidential Elections Amidst Controversies and Merchandising Craze
stories.summary: Brazil is gearing up for its presidential elections, with nearly 159 million voters expected to participate. The campaign has seen a surge in merchandise sales for candidates, particularly for President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Tensions are high as Lula and his far-right challenger, Flávio Bolsonaro, clash over issues of sovereignty and U.S. influence, while a controversy surrounding the country's patron saint, Our Lady of Aparecida, adds to the atmosphere ahead of the vote.

stories.title: Nationwide Protests Erupt in Spain Over Housing Crisis
stories.summary: On Saturday, tens of thousands of protesters took to the streets across Spain, demanding government action on the ongoing housing crisis. The demonstrations were sparked by the government's failure to pass emergency housing legislation after parliament rejected two key affordable housing decrees. This marks a significant escalation in the public's response to the housing situation in the country.

stories.title: North Korea Fires Ballistic Missile Amid Rising Tensions with South Korea
stories.summary: North Korea launched a ballistic missile from the Wonsan area into the Sea of Japan on Saturday morning, according to South Korea's military. This missile test follows heightened tensions between the two Koreas, particularly after South Korea demanded an apology regarding a mine blast that injured three South Korean soldiers in the Demilitarized Zone last month. The missile reportedly flew over 700 kilometers before landing in the sea.
